steps.name: Executor
steps.text: ...Target has been placed into custody and the lost medical supplies retrieved. One operator suffered a mild ankle sprain during the operation.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: That is all I have to report about the mission. I have been asked to communicate my superiors' gratitude for Rhodes Island's support of Lateran citizens abroad.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The Notarial Hall would be honored to welcome you while Rhodes Island is stationed near Laterano.

options: It was the right thing to do.
We'll go if we have time, Federico.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I will pass on your answer. If there is nothing else, I will take my leave.

options: One moment, Federico.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Do you have another task you need me to perform?

options: Many of our younger patients have improved.
Medical is throwing a party to celebrate.
I got a message telling me to dress up more, er, 'interesting'.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: 'Interesting'... that's rather vague. Are there any more details?

options: Maybe they think my clothes are too monotone.
Maybe I need to wear more colors.
Bibeak sent me a dozen party hats. Which do you think works best?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: They are all conical. The only difference is the color.

options: True.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I am afraid I cannot give you a useful opinion. I perceive all colors the same way.

options: People always praise your color coordination.
You wear a lot of colors.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: This an official Notarial Hall uniform. I did not choose it.

options: What about when you're off-duty?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The same.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I have seven sets of identical uniforms that I wear whether I'm on duty or off.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: You look disappointed, Doctor.

options: That's not it.
Just a bit.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Executor has been sitting there for a while. Am I imagining things, or has he not moved at all?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Not according to my measurements. You don't often see Sankta so quiet...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: You're new... you don't know...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Know what?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: One fugitive on the run, two hidden mines, three massive holes, and... leaky evenings beyond reckoning.
Ahem. What are you two doing? I'll slash your pay if I catch you talking bad about a guy behind his back.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: C-Closure! What are you doing here?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Just looking for the Doctor. There's been a question of what color hat to wear to the party. I'm curious if the Doctor's come to a decision yet.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Is that Sankta going to sit there all day? Rhodes Island is pretty big. Can't he sit somewhere else?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hey, Sankta! You'd better move. It's going to rain, and you're gonna wanna hurry if you're going back to Laterano, unless you're gonna make the trip in a downpour.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Closure the Vampire, Chief Engineer of Rhodes Island... threat level downgraded from Extreme to Low one year ago.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: No special action required.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: (Whisper) Should I feel insulted?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Do you have to be daydreaming here, of all places, Sankta?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I'm just pondering what color a party hat should be.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The Doctor asked you? Hmm... rapid fire! What color am I wearing right now?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Black and red.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: But your question does not answer mine. It does not help me determine the proper color for the hat.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Maybe you should install a color sensor and the associated algorithms to help you perceive the differences between colors.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'll even give you a discount.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The installation of mechanical parts in the human brain is impractical at current technology levels. In addition...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Your experience with cranial surgery is unreliable.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Adjusting reliability rating of Closure the Vampire to Extremely Low.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Alright, my bad, my bad, I shouldn't have made fun of you.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: What is this?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: An anonymous artist is holding an exhibition at the Lateran Basilica this weekend, and Rhodes Island got a few free tickets.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I was going to give them to the younger operators, but maybe this'll do you some good.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Now... can we talk about making some adjustments to my profile?

options: Closure kept the operator coming with me a secret. Never thought it would be you.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Being both an operator of Rhodes Island and a citizen of Laterano, I do not think it is a surprise that I am here.

options: I'm surprised you come to an art show in your free time.
I didn't think you would be interested in an art show.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Your doubts are justified. I prefer to spend my time testing and maintaining my weapons, and getting proper rest.

options: But you came anyway.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I had to supplement my knowledge on colors to complete the mission you gave me yesterday. What about you, Doctor? The Notarial Hall was not notified of your visit to Laterano.

options: It wasn't a mission, Federico.
This isn't an official visit.
The kids wanted me to go with them.

steps.name: Energetic Young Operator
steps.text: Did you need art credits for your finals too, Mr. Sankta?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: It is not part of my annual performance analysis.

steps.name: Sullen Young Operator
steps.text: No fair, Doctor. Why doesn't he need to take exams?

options: Want something to eat?
I'll buy you an ice cream so forget about it.

steps.name: Sullen Young Operator
steps.text: Thank you, Doctor. I'd like strawberry, please.

steps.name: Energetic Young Operator
steps.text: Pineapple!

options: What about you, Federico?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I do not need anything. I do have a membership card for the ice cream shop, though.

options: Thank you.
See you at the gallery.
You go in first. I'll find you later.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: You have been standing in front of this painting for a long time. I assume it is appealing to you.

options: Yes, it is.
I'm curious about the colors the artist used.
I'm interested in the shapes and figures on the canvas.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The color blue comprises 71% of the painting, followed by green and white.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Other colors comprise less than one percent and can be considered negligible.

options: Is that all you see, Federico?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The boundaries of the colors are clearly defined, indicating the artist's preference for order and principles.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: There are very few straight lines or corners. The principal elements are circles, ovals and curves, and the lines are smooth and round.

options: Do these visual elements give you any particular feelings?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I have studied the visual influence of shapes in order to understand the emotions of others. There are many cases that indicate one's subconscious preference for a shape is connected to their psychological profile.

options: Interesting. Elaborate.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The orderly and balanced arrangement of the forms indicate that the artist was in a calm and tranquil state of mind.

steps.name: Sullen Young Operator
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Sullen Young Operator
steps.text: I think my eyes are gonna burst from all the blue.

steps.name: Energetic Young Operator
steps.text: The artist must have been really excited when painting it.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: We came to opposite conclusions based on the colors and shapes used by the painting. How can one be calm and excited at the same time?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I do not understand.

options: People are complex.
Anything is possible.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Your Beatitude, Saint Federico, this is such a wondrous surprise. I thought the staff were out of their minds when they said they saw you in the crowd.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Good morning, Reverend Simeone. Is His Holiness here?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: No, I am on my own. And who might you be?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, from Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: It is an honor to meet you, Dr. {@nickname}.

options: The honor is all mine, Sir Simeone.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Are you here on official duty?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Of course not. Today is Sunday, it's the sabbath.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Don't tell anyone, but I'm the anonymous artist behind this exhibition. I didn't want it to be a distraction while I'm still a gun-knight.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: What of Your Beatitude? Are you really here to appreciate the art?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Yes, Reverend Simeone.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Now, you're the last man I expected to be joking. I know, I know, Notarial Hall business, right?

options: I can vouch that Federico's not here for anything complicated.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I came to learn more about colors.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: You've come to the right person, then.

options: You've piqued my interest, too.
What can you tell us?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: While there is a degree of subjectivity in individual perception of color, we have also achieved a degree of consensus over what different colors represent.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: For example, red is considered stimulating, and represents excitement and passion.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: As one who considers himself mild-mannered, however, I rarely use it in my artwork.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Five years ago, you...

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: (Loudly) Now, let me talk about my favorite color.

options: Let's hear what he has to say.
(Whisper) Although you're not the only one who's a little skeptical.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I noticed that you use a lot of blue in your artwork.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Very astute of you. The tranquility, reason and depth represented by blue is my life's pursuit.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: In addition, it also calms the mind, helping them feel peace and tranquility... hey, was that a camera flash?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Hey, what the hell are you doing, you little runt!

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Yeah, you! Who said you could use flash? Get away from my painting! Further!

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Now, where were we...?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Blue helps one feel peace and tranquility.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Yes, blue... the resting place of my soul, the symbol of eternity... such beauty...

steps.name: Exhibition Staff
steps.text: Excuse me, Reverend Simeone, there is something you need to know.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Pardon me, I should look into this.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: His words and actions are highly contradictory. I find it hard to trust the information he provided about the color blue.

options: One moment, Federico.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Do you find his statements credible?

options: Colors can have complex emotional implications. Maybe we can delve further.
There are many things affecting emotion. Color is only one of them.
There are more factors that need to be considered when thinking about the impact of color on emotion.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The natural flaw of man means that I will have to spend much time to achieve this goal.

options: But you're not afraid of the challenge, are you?
But you're never afraid.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: True, Doctor, I am not.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Excuse me, Your Beatitude, we have need of you.

options: Oh?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Closer, please. We can't be overheard...

options: What happened?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Doctor, you should leave with the young operators.

options: What about you?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I have an emergency mission.

steps.name: PA
steps.text: Dear guests, we regret to inform you that there has been an emergency. We ask that you remain calm and proceed to the nearest exit side for evacuation.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Why is there a bomb here?

steps.name: Exhibition Staff
steps.text: There was an armed altercation in the Basilica yesterday. We thought the explosives left behind by the suspect had been cleaned up.

steps.name: Exhibition Staff
steps.text: Is there anything Your Beatitude can do?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I believe that casualties can be avoided even if there is an explosion.

steps.name: Exhibition Staff
steps.text: But the whole gallery above... all the artwork...

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Understood. New mission objective: protect the artwork on exhibit.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Time is short. Action must be taken quickly.

steps.name: Exhibition Staff
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Make sure no one follows me.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: There is sufficient distance from the crowd and the artwork, and sufficient cover on the roof to keep the blast radius to three meters.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: This is an appropriate spot to move the bomb.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Set. Countdown. Decem, novem, octo, septem...

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Quinque, quattuor, tres, duo, unus.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: No significant difference between expected and actual blast radius. Damage to exterior buildings noted. A 1.75 square meter hole has appeared in the roof. There are no casualties, and no damage to artwork.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Bomb threat has been neutralized.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The bomb has been detonated on the roof. No harm has been done to personnel or the exhibit.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The danger has been eliminated. The exhibition may continue.

steps.name: Exhibition Staff
steps.text: Your Beatitude, er... you should leave, quickly, before...

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: You seem to have feelings of concern, fear... and regret.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The response is unexpected based on the outcome. Please elaborate.

steps.name: Exhibition Staff
steps.text: You left so quickly with the bomb that I didn't have the chance to tell you, but the most important work of art in the exhibition was...

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Get out of my way! Saint or not, that bastard is going to get it!

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: I spent an entire year painting that dome! I won't let this go unanswered!

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Stop right there!

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I never moved.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Well, you've got nerve, at least.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I apologize for damaging your work. I shall reassess the mission completion status and compensate you for your loss.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Compensate? You think the time and effort I spent on the dome can be made up for with money?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: If necessary, I can restore it to the precise condition it was in.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I have carefully observed every corner of the gallery, including the dome. It will not be difficult to restore it from memory.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Are you trying to insult me?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Even if you can recreate the touch of the brush, you could never restore the passion and inspiration in my heart and mind when I painted it!

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: 'The precise condition it was in'? You don't know what you're talking about.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Why the frown? Not happy?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: No, I am thinking about what else could be done.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I am trying to infer your emotions at the time through my memory of the artwork.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: What's the point, even if you could do it? It's become blurred with the memories, it shattered when the dome did.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: All that's left is the sky through the hole.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The sky...
The executor looks up at where the dome used to be, as the sun shines down gently through the hole.
He feels a gentle warmth on his face.

options: It's been raining heavily these past few days. I haven't had a chance to see the blue sky.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I thought you took the young operators back to the ship, Doctor.

options: Don't worry, they're safe at our branch office.
The young operators are safe. I came back because I was worried.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I am sorry that I cannot ensure that your visit will be smooth... I must make new plans.

options: Shh... look at the sky, Federico.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: There you are, Doctor.

options: I came to check on the injured children.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: We found the children in the cellar to be in a state of malnutrition, four of them severely, with one in critical condition.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Their odds of survival would have increased greatly if we arrived one day earlier.

options: Are you injured?
What's with your shoulder?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: There is a wound at the base of the shoulder.

options: What are you holding, Federico?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: A drawing from a child.

options: Looks like we have a very talented young artist on the ship.
What did you see up there?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The blue sky.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: The child told me that he was imprisoned in a place of darkness, but he saw a shade of blue just as he was about to lose all hope.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: It comforted him.

options: You didn't mention anything blue at the scene.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I believe he did, in fact, see it. I broke into the cellar from above. There was a high chance that he saw the blue sky.

options: Yes, the blue sky is comforting.
Yes, a shade of blue like the sky is comforting.

steps.text: Federico feels you pat him on the shoulder. He looks down at the blue sky on the drawing.

steps.name: Exhibition Staff A
steps.text: It's good that the rain's finally stopped. It's been overcast for so many days that I can feel mold growing on me.

steps.name: Exhibition Staff B
steps.text: The sun's so warm... I just want to lie down and take it in.

steps.name: Exhibition Staff A
steps.text: It drives all the darkness and gloom away.

steps.name: Exhibition Staff B
steps.text: Look, even Reverend Simeone is entranced by the sunlight.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: What a beautiful blue. I think I saw it in a dream.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: It blends perfectly with my artwork. All the blue I used on the dome was only there to complement its beauty.
After a few days of heavy rain, the sky is a shade of painted blue.
The wind spreads the paint out, from far to near, from deep to light, blending and stacking colors, dyeing it a beautiful shade between blue and green.
Everyone is looking up at it with an entranced expression, their hearts filled with happiness and comfort.
The feeling spreads through the streets, as passersby slow and diners put their forks and knives down...

options: Looks like the danger has passed.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Yes, the incident has been resolved, as you can see.

options: You said incident resolved, rather than mission complete.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I did not complete my mission, as a work of art was damaged in the bomb disposal process.

options: But everyone looks happy.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: That is because of the sky.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Sunday, sunny, the sky a rare shade of blue.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Those who see this shade of blue exhibit enlarged pupils and lift the corners of their mouths, indicating feelings of joy.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: More information is required to determine the correlation between this special shade of blue and positive emotions.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Bah, stop muttering over there.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: ...Understood.

options: (Pat him on the shoulder)
(Look into his eyes)
(Do nothing)

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I am unsure what this physical contact means.

options: No special meaning to it, Federico.
I just want you to look at the sky with me for a while.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: What are you trying to say, Doctor?

options: There's no need to remember all that.
What we really should remember is the color of the sky, here and now.

steps.text: After a moment of silence, the executor looks up again, at the clear blue sky through the hole.
His expression is calm and stoic, unlike the calm and easy expressions on the faces of the others.
You wordlessly cast your gaze at the sky with him.

options: Federico? I think it's time for us to go.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: How long have we been standing here?

options: One and a half hours.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: One and a half hours... I find that hard to believe.

options: All the staff have left. It's just the two of us here.
Look at your watch. A machine doesn't lie.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Confirmed that one hour, thirty-seven minutes and sixteen seconds have passed.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: This represents a significant deviation from the perceived passage of time.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I have never experienced it.

options: Are you alright?
You look uneasy.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I must go with you, Doctor, and receive a full examination from the Medical Department.

options: What happened?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: There is a high probability that this rare shade of blue represents a pathological factor for me. I must ascertain if it will affect my performance on future missions.
Three days later

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I apologize for the trouble I caused the Medical Department with my sudden request for examination.

options: It's okay. No trouble at all.
Don't worry about it.
Oh, and I just got a message from Closure.
She says you should meet her in Engineering.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Are you picking a boutonniere?

options: Yes, my attendance has been requested at an important occasion.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I recommend azure.

options: It's a memorial service for a scholar who recently passed away.
Azure? I'm going to a funeral.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Understood, azure is not suitable for such an occasion.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Thank you, Doctor. I request my leave if there are no other missions.

options: See you later, Federico.
I look forward to our next meeting.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: I've got it, Doctor.

options: What?
Tell me more.

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: Your jacket is navy-blue.

options: What?

steps.name: Executor
steps.text: See you later, Doctor.

options: My jacket... it's always been navy blue.
...Hehe.
